title: Whirlpool Adventure Course - Classic Course
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take a fun and thrilling experience with suspended obstacles and zip-lines high above the world-famous Whirlpool and Niagara River gorge. Your activity includes dozens of aerial climbing, zip-lining, jumping, and swinging games.

Classic Course
Take on 41 games, obstacles, and ziplines that get higher and more challenging as you go. Start on the lower level with challenges up to 20 feet high. Put your fear aside and climb the upper level with an additional 20 games and ziplines up to 40 feet in the air. 

Age: 5+
Minimum Height: 4'8"
Maximum Weight: 300lbs
Time: 90 minutes-120 minutes
